room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on Associated Medical Expenses if room category is higher than single room occupancy. No explicit ₹ or % cap on room rent itself, but upgrade triggers proportionate cuts.

icu.note: Policy explicitly states proportionate deduction will not be applicable on ICU Charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise monetary sub-limits found in the policy wording. All covered expenses paid up to Sum Insured.

deductible.note: A deductible is referenced and defined; the exact amount is specified in the Policy Schedule, not in the wording. Deductible applies once per policy year (individual/floater basis). Amount not stated in wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 12 months of continuous coverage from policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed specific diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 12 months from policy inception.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are explicitly excluded under Standard Exclusion Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus or no-claim bonus mentioned anywhere in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement of sum insured benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days prior to hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment for all eligible procedures is explicitly covered under Section 3.1.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalisation covered under Section 3.1 subject to Medical Practitioner certification.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment is not mentioned anywhere in the policy wording — neither covered nor explicitly excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ Donor Expenses (living donor hospitalisation for harvesting) covered under Section 3.1.

ambulance.note: Emergency Road Ambulance expenses covered for transfer between place of illness/accident and hospital, or between referral hospitals. No rupee cap stated in wording.

modern_treatments.note: Modern Treatment procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, etc.) explicitly covered under Section 3.1 up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: List I toiletries/personal comfort items are payable. Many standard consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) are subsumed into room/procedure charges per Lists II-IV and not separately payable. No separate consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly restricted to treatment within India only (Section 5.2.7).

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no look-back applied and claims cannot be contested except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual premium; 15-day grace period for monthly instalment premium.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD (unless add-on), external congenital anomaly, treatment outside India, self-inflicted injury, eyesight/hearing aids

optional_riders.display: Outpatient Treatment Benefit (OPD cover up to ₹5,000/yr per insured)
